user.title: Immersion Heater (E7+)
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Secure / Horstmann E7+ immersion controller.

method.title: How should we get the key?

commission.title: Commission the heater
commission.description:
On the heater, hold the Menu button for about 8 seconds until the display shows it is in commissioning mode, then press Submit.

This claims the device for Home Assistant, so the Secure phone app will no longer control it.

manual.title: Enter your key
manual.description: Paste the 16-byte BLE key for this device (32 hexadecimal characters).

error.not_reachable: Couldn't reach the heater over Bluetooth. Make sure a Bluetooth proxy is in range of it.
error.not_commissioning: The heater is not in commissioning mode. Hold Menu for about 8 seconds until the screen shows commissioning mode, then try again.
error.no_key: The heater was claimed but did not return its new key. Put it back in commissioning mode and try again.
error.ble_error: A Bluetooth error occurred while commissioning. Please try again.
error.timeout: The heater stopped responding. Check it is in range of your Bluetooth proxy, put it back in commissioning mode and try again.
error.bad_key: That doesn't look like a 32-character hex key.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the Home Assistant logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This immersion heater is already set up.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Read the weekly hot-water programme from the heater into Home Assistant. Returns it as a response and updates the Schedule sensor.

object_id.name: Object ID
object_id.description: Diagnostic: read this schedule object instead and return the raw reply without updating the Schedule sensor.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write the weekly hot-water programme to the heater. Give each day to change as a list of up to 3 on/off windows on the 15-minute grid; an empty list means off all day. Days left out keep their current windows.
